phases.title: Dependency Resolution & Packaging Rules
phases.notes: ProjectBuilder native/socket dependency resolution exists (ProjectBuilder.NativeDependencies.cs, PackageNativeDependencies). Added: DependencyCrawler.cs (Projects) walks changed + added tags one level (native refs + structured tag words), DependencyManifest writes build/dependencies.json with MissingReference / InvalidNativeReference / MissingProjectFile issues; PackageIdAllocator.cs allocates 0x0100-0x0CFF skipping installed + project ids. Checks: ProjectSystem.Tests DependencyChecks. Crawl now walks the build tag set (raw changes, compiled object edits, config bindings, added, generated) on the bytes the build writes; native-link issues carry the missing child kind (Texture, Audio, Buffer, ...), bare structured words stay Unknown; script references are not classified. Left: Studio Build does not call DependencyCrawler.Crawl(...).Write(...), PackageIdAllocator.For is unused by new-asset id flows (ObjectEditContext.Generated.cs, CollisionImport.cs, Authoring/Creation keep their own scans); no check plants a missing reference through an object edit (needs a registered ObjectEdit compiler in ProjectSystem.Tests)
